steps.title: First steps
steps.subtitle: Start managing your finances in less than 5 minutes with our quick guide.

items.title: Create your account
items.description: No credit card required. Only username and/or email and password.

items.title: Create your first category
items.description: Define custom categories to organize your expenses (e.g., Food, Transport, Leisure...).

items.title: Record your expenses
items.description: Add transactions from their section or easily from the dashboard.

news.title: Recent news
news.subtitle: Discover the latest improvements added to the platform.

items.title: Japanese language added. It is now possible to export and import data between accounts without user limitations.
items.description: You can now export data to a JSON file and import it into another account. This removes restrictions on data migration, allowing more flexible data management. Additionally, Japanese language support has been added.

items.title: Visual and logical bug fixes
items.description: Adapted styles for compatibility with browsers like Safari. Deleted categories and transactions are no longer considered for metrics calculation.
